newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH LONG DEBT YIELDS RISE WITH WEAKER U.S.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH LONG DEBT YIELDS RISE WITH WEAKER U.S.

text.p: Swedish long debt yields rose and the curve steepened, driven by losses in U.S. Treasuries and comments by German Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke.

Welteke said Germany was watching forex developments very closely but jobless rate did not allow Buba to turn interest rate screw and would not moves rates as long as there was no sign of inflation pressure.
The crown was stable against the mark.
* Six month T-bill rate down one basis point to 4.34 pct
* 10-year bond yield up six basis points to 6.58 pct
* Mark stable at 4.2945 against the crown vs 4.2940 Thursday
